content:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot upward momentum.
- Underestimate downward corrections after negative sentiment; model fails to react to bearish sentiment signals.
- Lag in response to sentiment shifts: model reacts slowly to sentiment turning points, especially when sentiment drops.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects after sharp moves, leading to premature reversal in direction.
- High sentiment + rising prices → model overestimates future prices; low sentiment + falling prices → model underestimates.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model consistently overestimates later periods (especially 20-30d) when sentiment is neutral or bullish.
- When sentiment is low (0.00–0.27), model underestimates true price, especially in the first 10 days of forecast.
- Model tends to ignore sentiment in early forecast days (1–5) and overweights recent price history.
